case: dielectric slab wave speed, eps_r=4, plane-wave line
geometry: 120 x 10 x 10 mm line; slab fills the domain; probes at 30 and 90 mm; Gaussian 4 GHz
boundary: PML at x ends (4*scale cells), PMC at y, PEC at z
note: The error decreases monotonically, but the order is below two and falls at the finest level. The correlation-delay estimator's resolution (~0.1-0.2 %) limits the fine end, so no second-order claim is made. The cavity TE101 study is the clean order evidence.
